scope: A cleanup after a full check of the app's code and safety.

topics.title: Speech stays on your PC
details: The Azure checkbox is gone from Input options. It did nothing unless a helper set up a hidden key.
Speech recognition now always runs on your PC. Your voice is never sent online for recognition.

topics.title: Less old code
details: Old parts that no one could reach were taken out. This makes the app smaller and easier to keep safe.
All your keys and commands work as before, old shortcut keys too.

topics.title: Updates are made in one place
details: Updates are now shared only by the checked build on GitHub. The old way to share them by hand is gone.
